src/domain/inventory/StockReservationService.ts: throws InsufficientStockError, a domain error, when a product does not have enough stock
src/domain/inventory/StockReservationService.ts: release() and commit() only pass the work on to the Product aggregate's methods

parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is a plain domain service. It applies stock reservation rules across several Product aggregates. In reserve(), it checks first that every product can cover its quantity, and only then reserves any of them. If one product falls short, it throws a domain error. The release() and commit() methods pass the work on to Product. The file has no persistence code, no transport or HTTP code, no framework code and no transaction handling. It only works on domain types: Product, Quantity and InsufficientStockError. Every responsibility fits the domain layer, and no ADR text was provided that says otherwise.
